title: HyBridge: Bridge-Guided Self-Supervised Hyperbolic Hypergraph Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.16351v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hypergraphs capture groupwise relationships among multiple nodes and often exhibit tree-like structures. Although hyperbolic space is well suited for modeling such structures, simply extending existing hypergraph representation learning (HRL) methods to hyperbolic space does not consistently improve performance. In this paper, we investigate the relationship between node structural properties and hyperbolic embedding radii and find that bridge nodes tend to lie closer to the center in graphs, whereas this relationship is not consistently observed in hypergraphs. We further find that conventional bridge score estimation may fail to capture the groupwise connectivity of hypergraphs. Motivated by these findings, we propose HyBridge, a self-supervised hyperbolic HRL framework that (1) estimates node bridge scores by considering the external connectivity of individual hyperedges, (2) learns node and hyperedge embeddings through hyperbolic h

translated_title: HyBridge：桥梁引导的自监督双曲超图表示学习
translated_abstract: 超图能够捕捉多个节点之间的群组关系，并且通常呈现出树状结构。尽管双曲空间非常适合建模这类结构，但简单地将现有的超图表示学习方法扩展到双曲空间并不能持续提升性能。在本文中，我们研究了节点结构属性与双曲嵌入半径之间的关系，发现桥梁节点在图中往往更靠近中心，而这一关系在超图中并不总是成立。我们进一步发现，传统的桥梁分数估计方法可能无法捕捉超图的群组连通性。基于这些发现，我们提出了HyBridge，一个自监督的双曲超图表示学习框架，它(1)通过考虑单个超边的外部连通性来估计节点桥梁分数，(2)通过双曲超……
tldr: 该论文提出HyBridge框架，通过考虑超边外部连通性来估计节点桥梁分数，实现了自监督的双曲超图表示学习，解决了传统桥梁分数估计无法捕捉超图群组连通性的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HyBridge, a self-supervised hyperbolic hypergraph representation learning framework that estimates node bridge scores by considering the external connectivity of individual hyperedges, addressing the limitation that conventional bridge score estimation fails to capture the groupwise connectivity of hypergraphs.
